name: Felgur Twocuts
label: Character
description: Felgur Twocuts is a blunt orc scout stationed at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. He coordinates Horde efforts against the regional centaur clans.
intro: Felgur Twocuts is a blunt orc scout stationed at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. He coordinates Horde efforts against the regional centaur clans.

p: Standing watch amid the bleak expanse of Ghost Walker Post in central Desolace, Felgur Twocuts has little patience for pleasantries. As a forward scout for the Horde, he assesses the threats facing travelers and settlers venturing west through the mountains, particularly the local Kolkar centaur.

Felgur directs Horde champions to cull the local centaur chieftains and collect bounties on the warring tribes who threaten to overrun the region. He is a central contact for anyone seeking to secure the Horde's foothold in Desolace.
